headline: The run stopped early at 3.8 h with "Stop, unlikely to close" after a human approved it, saving 15.2 plate hours out of a 19.0 h horizon.
summary: There were two checks, and both proposed "Stop, unlikely to close". At 1.9 h the evidence was P(90% closed by 19.0 h) = 0.057, which is at or below the 0.1 threshold, but no human approved the stop, so the run kept going. At 3.8 h the evidence was P(90% closed by 19.0 h) = 0.075, still at or below 0.1, and this time a human approved the stop. The run ended at 3.8 h, which saved 15.2 plate hours against the 19.0 h horizon. No flags or refusals were logged.
next_step: Look at the images and forecast up to 3.8 h to check that the wound really wasn't closing, then decide whether to repeat the assay under different conditions.
caveats: Research use only, not for diagnosis or treatment.
Simulated cells and simulator bands are labelled as simulation, not observation.
The stop is based on a forecast probability, not on seeing the outcome. The well was not imaged after 3.8 h, so we can't confirm whether it would have closed.
The LLM proposed both stops. Only the one at 3.8 h was approved by a human.
For research use only, not for clinical decisions.
